QuestInfo.name: [Sellas] Underwater Operation
QuestInfo.0:
Ollie told you that, while they were hauling Tana up from the sea in Esfera, something shiny fell from her and sank. 
Talk to Neinheart again to see what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Whatever fell from the Transcendent of Light, it was no ordinary trinket. You've joined the underwater operation to find it.
QuestInfo.2:
Whatever fell from the Transcendent of Light, it was no ordinary trinket. You've joined the underwater operation to find it.

Ollie, who was with you for the previous operation in Esfera, has joined as well.
